purpose: Reconstructed academic market-data research and trading-strategy case for study before resume use

optiver.task: Predict the second five-minute realized volatility from first-five-minute features; not the original competition's subsequent-ten-minute target
optiver.split: Random group split by time_id, shared across stocks; 70% training, 15% validation, 15% test; not a chronological split
optiver.selection: Select Ridge or gradient boosting by validation RMSPE only, then evaluate once on the reserved test groups

strategy.signal: Long when daily Close exceeds its trailing 200-observation simple moving average; otherwise cash
strategy.signal_price: Yahoo Close, a split-adjusted price series excluding dividend reinvestment
strategy.performance_price: Yahoo Adjusted Close, a vendor-adjusted dividend/split total-return proxy
strategy.execution: Observe a close, execute at the following session's close; do not earn that intervening return on the new position
strategy.selection: 200-session rule is fixed before results; sensitivity results do not choose the primary rule
strategy.limitations: Historical research holdout, not prospective live performance; no optimization, no shorting, no leverage, no options, no tax/market-impact model
